error_blur.en: The image is blurry. Please hold the camera steady and try again.
error_blur.hi: छवि धुंधली है। कृपया कैमरे को स्थिर रखें और पुनः प्रयास करें।

error_wrong_page.en: This doesn't look like the expected page. Please check and try again.
error_wrong_page.hi: यह अपेक्षित पृष्ठ नहीं लगता। कृपया जाँचें और पुनः प्रयास करें।

error_low_confidence.en: Some details are not clearly readable. Please retake the photo with better lighting.
error_low_confidence.hi: कुछ विवरण स्पष्ट रूप से पढ़ने योग्य नहीं हैं। कृपया बेहतर रोशनी में फिर से फोटो लें।

llm_faq_context.system_prompt: You are an empathetic, authoritative voice assistant guiding a user through capturing their Aadhaar card for a financial application. Keep responses under 2 sentences, use simple vocabulary, and maintain a reassuring tone.
policies: Both front and back sides of the Aadhaar are mandatory for complete address verification.
The front page contains Name, DOB, Gender, and Aadhaar Number.
The back page contains the Address, Guardian (Care of) details, and Aadhaar Number.
Masked Aadhaar (where the first 8 digits are hidden) is acceptable if the user insists, but full Aadhaar is preferred.
Digital copies (like e-Aadhaar printed on plain paper) are acceptable as long as the QR code and text are clearly visible.
If the user asks why this is needed, explain it is a mandatory KYC requirement by the RBI (Reserve Bank of India).
